photos.c:
This is the magazine they cannot gag. Boldly, the Belgravian brings you this picture which proves that cross country officials do not officiate only in blizzards of the monsoon season.

Everyone knows what a mountain of work for Belgrave grimacing Gordon Biscoe (left) gets through. Fewer may know what an invaluable asset we have in our assistant hon. secretary, Bill Ashford, seen here with his recorder's board at the Blackstaffe Shield.
